questions.stem: The dose-response curve is the plot of the administered dose (µg/kg body weight/day) on the X-axis versus the response (or effect) on the Y-axis. There are two types of DRCs, one is graded DRC and the other one is quantal DRC. Which of the following is TRUE regarding the log Dose-response curve?

options.label: A
options.text: If a dose is plotted on a logarithmic scale, the curve becomes sigmoid, and a linear relationship is seen

options.label: B
options.text: Comparison between agonist and study of antagonist is difficult

options.label: C
options.text: Steep slope of DRC indicates that a moderate increase in dose will markedly decrease the response

options.label: D
options.text: Drug with flat slope is dangerous

questions.answerText: If a dose is plotted on a logarithmic scale, the curve becomes sigmoid, and a linear relationship is seen
questions.solutionHtml:
If a dose is plotted on a logarithmic scale, the curve becomes sigmoid, and a linear relationship is seen
